item.title: Houston: Mild temperatures in the 60s, cold front on the way
item.description: This week will be dry and mild with temperatures reaching the upper 60s, but another front will move in over the weekend bringing cold temperatures and overnight lows in the 30s and 20s.

item.title: Democrats, White House strike spending deal that would avert government shutdown
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Democrats and the White House struck a deal to avert a partial government shutdown and temporarily fund the Department of Homeland Security as they consider new restrictions for President Donald Trump’s surge of immigration enforcement.
